scripts.desktop:build:windows: npm run prepare:sidecar && tauri build --bundles nsis --config src-tauri/tauri.local-build.conf.json && node scripts/verify-windows-pe.mjs --gui src-tauri/target/release/relayune-desktop.exe --sidecar-directory src-tauri/binaries && powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-windows-installer.ps1 -InstallerDirectory src-tauri/target/release/bundle/nsis
scripts.desktop:ci:windows: npm run prepare:sidecar -- --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis --config src-tauri/tauri.windows-ci.conf.json
scripts.desktop:release: npm run prepare:sidecar -- --target universal-apple-darwin --pre-sign-for-tauri && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg
